idea-plugin.name: Styled Markdown
idea-plugin.description:
Support for Styled Markdown (.smd) files: Markdown with containers, inline directives, styled spans, math, variables and front matter, written for people and AI agents alike.

  • Highlighting with the VS Code extension's TextMate grammar.
  • The Styled Markdown language server (smd lsp, shipped with the plugin): problems as you type with quick fixes, completion (block names, attributes, front matter, directives, link paths and anchors), hover, go to definition, the document outline and workspace symbols, and formatting.
  • Open Preview in Browser: the rendered page, exported with smd export --to html.

Needs Node.js 22 or newer, and an IDE with the LSP API (IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3+, PyCharm, WebStorm and the other JetBrains IDEs since 2025.1; not Android Studio).
